sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Public Tricycle Rickshaw Driver is a driving game that requires skill and strategy to succeed. The game's controls are simple, with WASD keys controlling the rickshaw's movement and the Esc key pausing the game. As you progress through the levels, you will encounter a variety of challenges, including narrow roads, pedestrians, and other rickshaws. Your goal is to navigate your rickshaw through these challenges while maintaining speed and control.

One of the key mechanics of the game is the rickshaw's speed. As you accelerate, your rickshaw will pick up speed, but you will also need to be careful not to exceed the speed limit. If you get caught speeding, you will incur a penalty, which can set you back in the game. This adds an extra layer of realism to the game, as you need to balance speed with caution.

Another important mechanic is the rickshaw's brakes. As you approach a stop or need to slow down quickly, you will need to press the brake key to slow down. The brakes can be a bit finicky, so you will need to practice using them to get the hang of it. With practice, however, you will become more comfortable using the brakes and be able to navigate the game's challenges with ease.

Overall, the game's core mechanics are simple yet addictive. With practice and patience, you will be able to master the rickshaw's movement and navigate even the most challenging levels.
